system.description: Also at 3rd level, you have mastered the art of transmuting certain enchantments into garments to further conceal their magical nature from prying eyes. By spending 8 hours with your sewing kit, you may transmute the enchantment from one Wondrous Item of Uncommon rarity or lower for which you have the schematic into a piece of mundane wearable clothing. This Wondrous Item cannot be consumed by its use and cannot be used to alter armor or weapons, but it can be used on cloaks, boots, hats, belts, and other similar garments. Any items that require attunement to function still require its wearer to do so, and these items still register as magical if detection magic such as identify or detect magic are cast within their vicinity. You may transmute a number of enchantments in this way equal to half your Intelligence modifier.
